question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Men, Engineers and Fathers
solution:
The diagram that best represents the relationship between Men, Engineers and Fathers is shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50581bc5fbbcc0c9a6e7ec9fe88c32582013cc4d7c4d85f49e33dcd14a43dfa1.png] 

Some men can be fathers and thus will be part of the father's category.

Some men can be engineers.

Some fathers can be engineers.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
